parameters.query:
SELECT
  m.id AS mission_id,
  m.ats_mission_id,
  m.mission_date,
  m.start_time,
  m.location,
  m.skill_required,
  m.status,
  m.recruiter_id,
  m.reminder_1_scheduled_at,
  m.reminder_2_scheduled_at,
  m.reminder_3_scheduled_at,
  m.reminder_1_sent_at,
  m.reminder_2_sent_at,
  m.reminder_3_sent_at,
  c.id AS candidate_id,
  c.name AS candidate_name,
  c.phone,
  c.email,
  r.email AS recruiter_email,
  r.slack_user_id AS recruiter_slack
FROM missions m
JOIN candidates c ON c.ats_candidate_id = m.ats_candidate_id
LEFT JOIN recruiters r ON r.id = m.recruiter_id
WHERE m.status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REMINDER_1_SENT','REMINDER_2_SENT','REMINDER_3_SENT')
AND m.mission_date >= CURRENT_DATE
AND c.opt_out = FALSE
ORDER BY m.mission_date ASC;
